cross_verification.note_en: Qatar's Ministry of Interior (MOI) — General Administration of Nationality, Borders & Expatriate Affairs / Nationality and Travel Documents Department — is the passport-issuing authority (portal.moi.gov.qa). Direct fetches of MOI, Hukoomi, and MOFA pages (portal.moi.gov.qa/wps/.../nationalitytraveldocuments, portal.moi.gov.qa open-data passport section, hukoomi.gov.qa) returned only navigation/fee/contact content — no detailed photo specification page could be located or confirmed. Third-party visa-photo vendor sites disagree sharply with each other on size (35×45mm / 38×48mm / 30×40mm) and background (white / blue / light grey), which is itself a signal that no single reliable figure exists publicly; per the sourcing policy none of these third-party figures are used here. All requested fields are left unverified pending a directly-readable official specification document.
